policies.name: storage_objects_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation: a row is visible only when org_id equals the transaction-local app.org_id (or the transaction carries app.rls_bypass). Prisma cannot express policies.

policies.name: storage_object_chunks_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of upload parts; the chunk carries its own org_id because a policy cannot join through its parent.

policies.name: ai_runs_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of background AI runs, whose request column holds the full prompt.

policies.name: ai_usage_events_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of AI usage accounting; a row with a NULL org_id is visible to the bypass (system) client only.

policies.name: groups_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of sharing groups (PP-7.1): a group lives inside one organization and is never a tenant.

policies.name: group_members_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of group memberships; the row carries the group's org_id (composite key to groups) because a policy cannot join through its parent.

policies.name: group_invites_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of group invitations, which hold invitee e-mail addresses.

policies.name: grants_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of grants (PP-7.2): a grant shares one record inside its organization and can never name another organization's user or group.

policies.name: org_settings_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of an organization's settings overrides (PP-8.1): one row per organization, read and written only inside runInOrg.

policies.name: org_credentials_org_isolation
policies.reason: Organization isolation of organization-owned encrypted credentials (PP-8.8): an org's key is visible only inside that organization's scope.
